claimant_lives_in_uk.description: Whether the claimant lives in the UK.

children.description: A list of children the claimant is claiming for.

lives_with_claimant.description: Whether the child lives with the claimant.

in_approved_education.description: Whether the child is in approved education or training (e.g. A-levels, GCSEs, NVQ up to level 3). Only relevant for children aged 16-19.

in_extension_period.description: Whether the child (aged 16 or 17) has left education and registered with a government-sponsored careers service or the armed forces (qualifying for a 20-week extension).

upkeep_per_week.description: The amount in £ per week the claimant contributes towards the child's upkeep (food, clothes, pocket money, etc.). Only relevant if the child does not live with the claimant.

another_claimant_has_priority.description: Whether another person who also lives with the child has priority for claiming Child Benefit.

another_claimant_lives_with_child.description: Whether someone who lives with the child is already claiming Child Benefit for them.

care_weeks.description: The number of weeks the child has been in local authority care.

care_home_24h_per_week.description: Whether the child spends at least 24 hours per week at home while in local authority care.

hospital_weeks.description: The number of weeks the child has been in hospital or residential accommodation.

claimant_spends_on_child.description: Whether the claimant regularly spends money on the child (e.g. food, clothes, books) while the child is in hospital or residential accommodation.

is_fostered.description: Whether the child is fostered by the claimant.

council_pays_for_child.description: Whether the local council pays towards the child's accommodation or maintenance.

works_24_plus_hours.description: Whether the child works 24 or more hours per week in paid employment.

started_apprenticeship_in_england.description: Whether the child has started an apprenticeship in England.

receives_qualifying_benefits.description: Whether the child receives qualifying benefits in their own right, such as Universal Credit or Employment and Support Allowance.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Hello! I'd be happy to help you determine your eligibility for Child Benefit. To do this, I'll need to ask you a few questions about your situation and your children.

Let me start with the first question:

**Do you have any children under the age of 16, or any children aged 16-19 who are in approved education or training?**

conversation.author: actor
conversation.text: Hi, yes I do! I have one child - my son Alex. He's 17 and he's still in sixth form doing his A-levels.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Thank you for that information! It's great to know about Alex. Since he's 17 and still in sixth form doing A-levels, that's approved education, which is helpful for eligibility.

Now I need to gather some more details about your circumstances:

**Do you live in the UK?**

conversation.author: actor
conversation.text: Yes, I live in the UK - we're in Manchester.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Excellent, thank you for confirming that. Now I need to understand your living arrangement with Alex:

**Do you live with Alex, or does he live with someone else?**

conversation.author: actor
conversation.text: He lives at home with me, yes.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Perfect, that's helpful to know. Now I need to understand a bit more about your immigration status and circumstances:

**Do you have British citizenship, settled status under the EU Settlement Scheme, or any other right to reside in the UK?**

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Great, thank you for confirming that. Just to make sure I have all the information I need:

**Are you currently the only person claiming Child Benefit for Alex, or is someone else also claiming for him?**

conversation.author: actor
conversation.text: No, I'm the only one - nobody else is claiming Child Benefit for him.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Perfect! I now have all the information I need to assess your eligibility for Child Benefit for Alex.

Let me review your situation:

- You are a British citizen living in the UK (Manchester)
- You live with your son Alex
- Alex is 17 years old and currently in sixth form doing A-levels (approved education)
- You are the only person claiming Child Benefit for him

Based on the Child Benefit eligibility rules, you meet all the key criteria:

1. **Responsible for a child under 20 in approved education** - Alex is 17 and in sixth form (A-levels), which counts as approved education
2. **Living with the child** - You live with Alex
3. **Right to reside in the UK** - You are a British citizen
4. **Single claimant** - Only you are claiming for Alex

You are eligible to claim Child Benefit for Alex.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Excellent news! **You are eligible to claim Child Benefit for Alex.** 

If you haven't already done so, you can make your claim for Child Benefit. Make sure to have information ready about Alex's education to confirm he's in approved education (sixth form A-levels).

Is there anything else you'd like to know about Child Benefit eligibility?
